'''Hunter Roney''' is a Star Wars CCG player. In January 2005 he was a member of the team TRFE with Zach Tartell and [[Andrew Shuman]].<ref name="pcf-4349-60061">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60061#60061 next upstate NY event 1/29 at Altered States in Syracuse], Zach Tartell (LonelyBaritone), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050223222006/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59401%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
